# ase01: validate each coordinate conversion against its own observation epoch

Parent `914cf67173be7c5231ccaa2878e4292d236b71e4`, base bot
`pi_actor-scene-layout-01`; candidate `bots/pi_actor-scene-epoch-01/`.
Use the existing Pi bridge and keep all edits inside the candidate. No games,
uploads, ranked changes or infrastructure changes on Pi.

## Source-supported defect

The parent's coordinate conversion correctly fixes all six packed-bitboard
representation errors. However, `LiveBackend::scalar` ends with
`if(!current(turn))throw Halt{Status::stale};`, where `turn` was captured in the
backend constructor and includes the initial `observation_version` revision.

Real `observations.cpp` implements `invalidate_observations()` by clearing its
cache and incrementing `revision`; `observation_version()` returns that revision.
Every successful controller motion/channel/defensive action invalidates it.
Thus a fresh capture after a legitimate first action has a new observation
revision but the same actor/life/round. The conversion compares this fresh
revision with the constructor's old revision and throws stale. This prevents
the required second motion and health-recall continuation. Channel cancellation
and post-defense refresh have the same problem; post-recall capture also fails.

The supplied `adapter_scene.cpp` mocks `observation_version(){return0;}` and
`invalidate_observations(){}`. That is incompatible with production revision
semantics and hides the failure. Native source syntax and constant-revision
tests cannot establish correct refreshed continuation. The parent is being
rejected before release games; do not describe it as a measured strength loss.

## Exact production correction

Correct only the freshness boundary in `LiveBackend::scalar`:

- After verifying the live dispatch round/actor/life/reserve, capture a **local
  conversion-entry Epoch**. Its revision belongs to this invocation, not the
  constructor. Capture it before the coordinate export/conversion.
- Preserve the existing checked `positions()` query, dimension/count/coordinate
  validation, owned byte array and post-conversion reserve check.
- Require full epoch equality with that local conversion-entry Epoch before
  returning the array. Any actor/life/round/revision change during this conversion
  remains stale. Do not remove revision checking or compare only round.
- Do not mutate or advance the constructor's `turn` to make a check pass. It
  remains the dispatch identity used by the existing checks. A new local
  conversion can legitimately begin with a newer revision after an action;
  it must be internally coherent and the enclosing capture/defense still
  enforces its own scene epoch.

All other production files remain byte-identical to the parent. Within
`recovery_sdk.cpp`, preserve every behavior outside this scalar epoch boundary.
Do not alter `recovery_tiles.h`, planner policy, thresholds, attempts, geometry,
static cache semantics, guard outcomes, caller routing, defense or economics.
Do not bundle the static-home detour limitation or bookkeeping changes.

## Actual adapter regression tests

Correct the test seam to use production revision semantics. Prefer mechanically
using the exact production observation-version/invalidation functions in the
native adapter fixture, or explicitly assert the identical increment behavior
if extracting their surrounding cache is impractical. Do not make the SDK mock
silently update the backend's constructor epoch.

Run the actual SDK wrappers plus returned production adapter/controller:

1. Successful ordinary motion updates actual position/allowance and observation
   revision, then a fresh same-turn capture succeeds. A supported second dash
   or other controller continuation remains expressible after revalidation.
2. Successful dash followed by fresh capture can choose an ordinary move. The
   predicted second action is never issued without that refresh.
3. Move into a fresh safe health-recovery state, then health recall in the same
   turn. Post-recall capture returns a channeling outcome, not false stale.
4. Active recall cancellation changes revision; fresh permissions/capture permit
   the bounded faster-home first step where the actual flags support it.
5. Defensive action changes revision; fresh capture succeeds and footer uses
   changed health/foes/permissions. The current live heal targets allies only;
   do not invent a self-heal host effect or widen targeting. Keep the existing
   scripted controller test where changed observed health releases the latch
   separately from actual adapter defense-refresh coverage.
6. Reusing the **old Scene** to issue another action still fails freshness.
   A revision change inside positions()/conversion is stale, not accepted merely
   because normal post-action revision changes are now supported.
7. Actor/life/round rollover before/during/after conversion rejects later action,
   preserving any earlier committed action exactly once. Stale/incomplete
   results bypass all further defense/footer. Boolean false-return host actions
   retain their existing observation invalidation and cannot reuse an old scene.
   Unexpected thrown SDK errors continue to propagate without continuation;
   do not add exception invalidation behavior outside this scalar-only repair.
8. Preserve all coordinate shape/empty/full/malformed/odd-map/defensive-mask
   controls and completed static-cache rollover/reuse checks from the parent.

Keep required host transitions explicit: real action wrappers must call the
mocked host mutation, and production invalidation must advance the revision.
Report which fixture actions and continuations actually executed. A direct
planner result alone is not this regression test.

Run unchanged292 controller assertions, inherited source/state checks and all
production current-SDK syntax. Update source-preservation checks for this exact
parent and narrow correction. Update IMPLEMENTATION.md with the changed lines,
test semantics, actual results and limitations. Native mocks do not establish
engine fuel or competitive improvement.

## PC follow-through

PC reviews exact source and independently reruns the actual adapter regression
before release. Then retain the same8construction games, Swirl/Lanes/Elkring/
Guardians both sides versus exact C02, current CLI5/engine3. Same original
construction gates and no standalone win threshold; no automatic80. Require
real recovery activation and same-turn movement followed by health recall;
missing coverage is incomplete. Compare original and defective atc01 controls,
while reporting asl01 as unplayed. These are reused development conditions,
not fresh confirmation. No upload or ranked change.
